data.name: Cosma
data.gender_notes: Cosma is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘kosmos’, meaning ‘order’ or ‘harmony’. In Christian context, it can be interpreted as a name reflecting the order and harmony of the universe created by God. The name Cosma carries the meaning “Order, harmony, cosmos” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cosma usually hope their child will grow to embody order, harmony, cosmos and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes harmony and order in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Cosma belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Order, harmony, cosmos.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cosma total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קוסמה
in_hebrew.meaning: קוסמה היא שם שפירושו סדר ויופי בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קוסמה מקורו במילה היוונית 'קוסמוס' שפירושו סדר ויופי. הוא משמש גם כשם נשי וגם כשם גברי, ויש לו שורשים עמוקים בתרבות היהודית והנוצרית. השם קוסמה מופיע בתרגומים העבריים של הטקסטים הנוצרים, ומשמש כזכר וגם כנקבה.

in_greek.name: Κόσμα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κόσμα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'κόσμος' που σημαίνει τάξη και ομορφιά. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος 'κόσμος' χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει το σύμπαν και την τάξη του. Ο όνομα Κόσμα ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και χρησιμοποιήθηκε και ως αρσενικό και ως θηλυκό όνομα.

in_latin.name: Cosma
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Cosma is derived from the Greek word 'kosmos', meaning order and beauty. In the Latin tradition, the name Cosma was used to signify harmony and balance. It was also the name of several early Christian saints, adding to its spiritual significance in the Christian tradition.

in_english.name: Cosma
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cosma originates from the Greek word 'kosmos', meaning order, harmony, and beauty. It has been used in various Christian traditions, symbolizing balance and spiritual growth. Historically, Cosma has been associated with early Christian saints, emphasizing its significance in Christian heritage. The name represents a blend of cultural richness and spiritual depth.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Cosma can be seen as representing the unity and harmony within the believing community, as well as the order and harmony brought about by God in the universe. This name serves as a reminder of the interconnectedness and unity that exists within the divine plan and within the Christian faith.

It embodies the spirit of exploration and understanding, inviting one to seek knowledge and wisdom in the vast expanse of life and the cosmos.
